# Curated Gems

> A community-driven directory of the best free, privacy-friendly software, apps and AI tools — handpicked alternatives that prioritize quality, open-source values, and great UX.

Curated Gems helps creators, makers, and entrepreneurs find their next favorite tool in three clicks or fewer. Every tool is reviewed and categorized.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Featured tools, categories, and search.
- [Tools Directory](/tools): Browse the complete catalog of curated tools.

## Categories

- [AI Tools](/tools/ai): Curated AI and machine-learning tools.
- [Design Tools](/tools/design): Design, UI and creative tools.
- [Development Tools](/tools/development): Developer tools and frameworks.
- [Productivity Tools](/tools/productivity): Productivity and workflow apps.
- [Marketing Tools](/tools/marketing): Marketing, growth and analytics tools.
- [Writing Tools](/tools/writing): Writing and content creation tools.
- [Video Tools](/tools/video): Video editing and production tools.
- [Photography Tools](/tools/photography): Photo editing and organization tools.
- [Music Tools](/tools/music): Music creation and audio tools.
- [Communication Tools](/tools/communication): Chat, meetings and collaboration.
- [Security Tools](/tools/security): Privacy and security tools.
- [Finance Tools](/tools/finance): Finance and accounting tools.
- [Education Tools](/tools/education): Learning and education resources.
- [Entertainment Tools](/tools/entertainment): Entertainment and media tools.
- [Business Tools](/tools/business): Business and operations tools.
- [Utilities](/tools/utilities): General utility tools.
